source: Freeze counterfactual choices before opening training or development terminal scores. Eight separate archived source maps; two physically independent development starts; screening histories excluded.
sampling: Exactly two windows per original source trajectory (two source seats per eight maps). At t205 play the archived candidate side; at t271 play the other physical side. Alternate quota: desired loaded collector (cargo>=40) if (map index+original seat+window index) is even, otherwise desired light collector. Within the eligible group choose largest actual residual T1 mixed probability entropy, tie by lower slot; if a group is empty take any available collector with >=2 legal choices, if none record and skip. Six iid uniforms per root from SeedSequence([8721103,map,physical seat,t]). At that slot apply same U in both actual live 75/25 base/residual CDFs, greedily complete real prefixes and run the original guard. Record exact marginal probability of the issued physical whole-team command, each latent interval, both official terminal rewards, map and opponent. Use all six draws. Identical executed command under deterministic continuations is played once; execute original greedy reference as well.
capacity: Use actual v1 Sapling worker hidden vectors on publicly re-created old roots at 60,110,155,205,238,271 on all 16 training source trajectories, both original roles never train on demonstrations. For each time use same side rule as the nearest training stage (original candidate at t<=205, other side thereafter). Record all workers on corrected greedy prefix. Fit map-equal ridge=.01 from those vectors to centered standardized log1p cargo, current toroidal distance to own base /14 and opportunity for a strictly lighter enemy collector to enter current square in one move. Weight vector 5 moves x 3 fitted state features=15 coefficients. Fold them into Sapling FP32 whead.weight/bias. True old/new probabilities use those deployed float32 matrices incl downstream. No update to partner or trunks. Shared worker head also acts on planters.
loss: Six iid joint actions per eligible root; advantage uses other five official U and other five official margin. Divide within-root LOO(U) by max(RMS, .04), plus .1 times LOO(margin)/max(RMS,750). Equal maps and equal roots on each. Clip each map gradient L2 to .15 before map mean. Fixed step .4, at most ten halvings. Require actual unscaled U PPO gain >0, combined gain >1e-10 and positive on >=4 training maps; all old positive support must remain and each root KL<=.02. PPO clip [.8,1.2]. Else freeze zero. No selection on held outcomes.
primary: All eight complete proxy games on two new maps against selected opponent, paired/same physical seat and starting map. Report observed WDL, official margin and U, every map and seat, independent cash accounts and real command contribution. Retain candidate for next study only if both map mean U positive, both map mean margin nonnegative, signed true physical change, no fewer observed wins, and independent execution evidence. No original game or formal draw.
budget: CPU3 nice19 single numerical thread; 16 screening continuations, <=32 x (6 sampled plus 1 original) distinct training endings, followed by exactly eight whole proxy games. Record throughput and scores. Never run the original Master3s2 or access another experiment’s new native results.
